description: Young women in 1920s cloche hats and long coats chat on a wet cobbled street beside a brick building with a glowing open doorway. A large sign on the wall reads POLLING STATION, and a smaller hanging sign on the right has lettering. A queue of men in flat caps and a uniformed policeman stand behind them. Gas lamps and dark buildings fill the background; the painting fills the frame.
reason: The brick wall carries a large painted sign reading POLLING STATION, and a small hanging sign on the right also has lettering. Repaint without any words.
